paragraphs: Mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 1:14, reporting in the name of R' Yonah. Seder HaDorot says, “I did not find it.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: ש״ר פ״א-יד is read as Shemot Rabbah chapter 1 section 14; סה״ד is Seder HaDorot in this attribution. The “I did not find it” statement belongs to that cited work, not this reviewer’s search. Its unstated object is not forced into him rather than it; no fresh edition verification is claimed.
HaChaver retains the supplied החבר designation; associate is a possible lexical gloss whose precise sense is not established here. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
